findingDetails.title: Orphan-sweep kill switch bypassable via the library surface
findingDetails.scopeProof: grep -n "isSweepEnabled|applySweep|SPECKIT_SESSION_START_ORPHAN_SWEEP" process-sweep.ts shows env var read once at line 394, exported applySweep at line 232 without the same guard

claimAdjudication.claim: applySweep does not honor the documented kill switch when called directly
claimAdjudication.counterevidenceSought: any in-repo caller that passes enabled: isSweepEnabled(env) from a non-CLI path
claimAdjudication.alternativeExplanation: kill switch is CLI-only by design — not supported by the help banner at line 385 which presents it as the disable for the apply command regardless of caller
claimAdjudication.downgradeTrigger: if a future caller wants to bypass the switch, it must opt-in explicitly; the default-undefined path is the surprise

findingDetails.title: Plan-time parent-pid gate leaves freshly-orphaned daemons alive (false-negative window)
findingDetails.scopeProof: grep -n "row.ppid|live-parent-preserved" process-sweep.ts shows the gate at line 203 is the only consumer of plan-time ppid inside applyCandidate; the apply-time fresh re-check at line 215-216 only fires if the plan-time gate already passed

claimAdjudication.claim: a daemon whose parent dies between planSweep and applySweep is not reaped
claimAdjudication.counterevidenceSought: any test that exercises parent-dies-between-snapshots — none in orphan-daemon-reaping.vitest.ts
claimAdjudication.alternativeExplanation: the gate is fail-safe — refusing to reap is the conservative choice; only false-positive safe, false-negative leaks orphans across session boundaries
claimAdjudication.downgradeTrigger: if the design intent is to require a SECOND apply pass after a grace window to catch newly-orphaned daemons, the gate is correct as written

findingDetails.title: Wall-clock grace window vulnerable to NTP adjustment
findingDetails.scopeProof: grep -n "Date.now|Date.parse|monotonic|process.hrtime|performance.now" process-sweep.ts — no monotonic clock usage

findingDetails.title: Apply-time socket-peer check passes empty socketPath, broadens the filter to ALL sockets
findingDetails.scopeProof: Two call sites — line 152 (evidence build) and line 219 (apply re-check) — only the latter passes empty string

findingDetails.title: run-tests.mjs hardcoded 10-minute default timeout is excessive for the mcp-server lane
findingDetails.scopeProof: One DEFAULT_TEST_RUN_TIMEOUT_MS constant, one env-var override, no per-lane tuning at lines 51-55

findingDetails.title: git-live-follow.sh LOCK_KEY uses CRC32 truncation only — collision risk in large worktree fleets
findingDetails.scopeProof: One LOCK_KEY derivation, one use site (lines 84-85)

findingDetails.title: git-live-follow.sh log rotation mv-then-truncate can lose the only historical copy
findingDetails.scopeProof: One rotation function, two call sites (lines 116, 195). No size cap on .log.1; no second historical tier

findingDetails.title: git-live-follow.sh lock acquisition has TOCTOU race between check and write
findingDetails.scopeProof: One lock_held, one acquire_lock, no atomic primitive at lines 125-142

findingDetails.title: paths.ts isTestContext is env-only; a vitest worker without env inheritance silently loses isolation
findingDetails.scopeProof: Single check site at line 67-71; relied upon by assertDatabaseIsolation at line 95

findingDetails.title: paths.ts workspace-root walk uses symlinked dirname; symlinked deployment can mislead root resolution
